active_experiments.problem: AI-assisted intraday trade review lacks normalized minute tape, same-time market amount, benchmark-relative strength, and explicit execution evidence.
active_experiments.baseline: Provider-neutral Eastmoney-primary and Tencent-fallback adapters, a typed evidence service, JSON CLI, and four read-only MCP tools are implemented locally and awaiting bounded verification and review.
active_experiments.outcome_metric: A private owner-supplied acceptance sample returns no-lookahead decision context and factual 5/15/30-minute outcomes with explicit freshness, provenance, gaps, and no trade authority.
active_experiments.smallest_experiment: Verify the 2026-08-07 private sample plus deterministic offline fixtures, CLI and MCP transports; stop at a Draft PR.
safety_boundaries: Read-only evidence and user-confirmed trade review only
No broker connection, order placement, cancellation, or automatic recommendation
No cross-provider minute merging; fallback and conflicts stay explicit
Missing, stale, blocked, and no-data states cannot be converted to zero or authority
Private executions and live artifacts remain ignored and local
active_experiments.kill_criterion: Stop if real minute evidence cannot be reproduced, no-lookahead fails, private executions enter tracked artifacts, or MCP exposes any write/trade capability.

queued_experiments.problem: IR-001 passes one offline case, but the local poller and thresholds have no multi-session 09:25/09:35/10:00 shadow evidence and external mapping is still a scenario input.
queued_experiments.baseline: IR-001 has 255 no-lookahead snapshots and 15 rule transitions; IR-002 P0 now has immutable observations, monotonic live peaks, explicit freshness/authority, execution-ledger re-entry guards, and checkpoint scheduling, but still no open-session calibration sample.
queued_experiments.outcome_metric: Across multiple live shadows, record alert latency, false escalation, missed protection, provider gaps, re-entry blocks, opportunity promotions, and whether substantive state-change notifications would be useful.
queued_experiments.smallest_experiment: Use the hardened double-click scheduler for 09:25/09:35/10:00 shadow_only captures without notifications; review one session at a time.
safety_boundaries: No live notification until multi-session state-change evidence passes review
No full-A-share scan; keep 20-30 liquid themes
No scenario external mapping may be relabelled as verified market data
Missing and stale values remain explicit and cannot authorize new exposure
No automatic order placement or holdings overwrite
IR-002 shadow output cannot contain position-action sizing or trade authority
queued_experiments.kill_criterion: Stop or recalibrate if alerts arrive after the decision window, false escalation dominates, provider gaps mask state, or opportunity confirmation encourages added risk after the account protection floor breaks.

queued_experiments.problem: InsightRadar has a structurally complete Harness but no behavioral baseline proving which controls improve real tasks.
queued_experiments.baseline: Harness structure scores 100/100, but no versioned 20-30-task suite or four-profile comparison exists.
queued_experiments.outcome_metric: Every eligible task reports deterministic success, evidence correctness, false completion, scope drift, privacy, recovery, token or context volume when available, tool calls, elapsed time, and human corrections across declared profiles.
queued_experiments.smallest_experiment: Plan and run a five-task pilot across the four profiles before scaling the accepted schema to 20-30 tasks.
safety_boundaries: Use synthetic or private local tasks only
No holdings, broker data, credentials, or raw private conversations in public artifacts
Deterministic checks are primary; model judging is secondary
No benchmark result grants trade authority or model-superiority claims
queued_experiments.kill_criterion: Stop expansion if the five-task pilot cannot produce reproducible deterministic verdicts or leaks private/secret data.
